label: D1 after an a2 choice that led rarely to S1
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only at D1 (94% of mass), with a weaker tail at GO and never at D2. Its main trigger is D1 right after a trial where the agent chose a2 and the transition was rare (it reached S1). It almost never fires after a1 choices (prev_action==1 holds 0.3% of mass). Dev: P=0.68, R=0.54, mass recall 0.78. It is more selective after rare-unrewarded a2 trials (P=0.74) than after rare-rewarded ones (P=0.57), and more when S2 is the hidden good state (P=0.77), but splitting on these lowers recall. Restricting to an upcoming a2 choice (future action) did not help (F1 0.59). Misses: small GO activations on a2-choosing trials, and D1 on the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous transition is not recorded (about 15% of mass). Also lifted in mid-episode trials 30-50 and with strongly negative choice logits (a2 preferred). Recorded predicate uses only observed history.
